# #56 — feat: REST API for Python client access

Parent: #53 (Requirement 2)

## Goal
Add REST API routes alongside MCP for direct HTTP access from Python clients (rTech/Hermes `OpenBrain` class). Same auth, same logic, no MCP handshake required.

## Changes
- Extract service functions from tool handlers into `src/services/` (thought, decision, person, session, search)
- MCP tool handlers become thin wrappers calling services
- New `src/rest-api.ts` with Express routes:
  - `POST /api/v1/thoughts` — write thought
  - `POST /api/v1/decisions` — write decision
  - `POST /api/v1/persons` — upsert person
  - `POST /api/v1/sessions` — save session
  - `GET /api/v1/search` — search by namespace
  - `GET /api/v1/entries/:table/:id` — fetch by ID
  - `GET /api/v1/namespaces` — list namespaces
  - `GET /api/v1/duplicates` — dedup check
- Same Bearer token auth middleware
- Register routes in `src/index.ts`

## Acceptance criteria
- Python client can write a thought via `POST /api/v1/thoughts` with Bearer token
- Search returns results filtered by namespace
- No MCP session/initialize required for REST routes
- MCP endpoint unaffected

## Depends on
#54 (namespace params), #55 (embedding robustness)

## Blocks
#57 (Dreamer promotion REST endpoints)
